source: SteelBench sample/clip_BF_CDI_Ground_CC2_20251111_000745_0031 (15 s, 1080p, 25 fps; clear, low sun)
method: Held out: none of these cameras was used to develop or debug the rules (they are in the 50-clip set, which the clip-level sweeps saw only as totals). Zones drawn and events labelled by eye from the raw frames at 1 fps (no pipeline overlay), with zoomed crops of each person, before the pipeline was run on them. Boxes are in source pixels; a person's box at time t is interpolated between keyframes.
